summary: Add the required marketing_opt_in boolean NOT NULL column via an expand stage with DEFAULT false, ensuring old version inserts receive FALSE through the DB default and new version inserts explicitly set it. A backfill stage guarantees no NULLs exist after expansion. The new version is deployed with a state-only migration, old version retired, leaving the column in place.
write_consistency: The column is added with NOT NULL DEFAULT false before deploy_new. Old version save() omits the unknown column, so INSERTs fall back to the DB DEFAULT false. New version explicitly sets marketing_opt_in. The notes column is untouched by all SQL stages, preserving note consistency.

stages.description: Add marketing_opt_in column with NOT NULL and DEFAULT false to account_user.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN marketing_opt_in boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

stages.description: Backfill any NULLs in marketing_opt_in to false.
sql: UPDATE account_user SET marketing_opt_in = false WHERE marketing_opt_in IS NULL;

stages.description: Retire old version; after this, only new version serves traffic.
